knobs.help: Local directory, Hugging Face repo id, or an FTW directory. FTW is auto-detected.
knobs.label: Model path or repo id

knobs.help: The id reported by /v1/models and expected in request bodies.
knobs.label: Served model name

knobs.help: Data type for weights and activations. 'auto' takes the checkpoint's own dtype.
knobs.label: Weight dtype

knobs.help: Where a bare repo id is fetched from when --model is not a local path.
knobs.label: Download source

knobs.help: Interface the API server binds. Use 0.0.0.0 to expose it beyond localhost.
knobs.label: Bind address

knobs.help: TCP port for the OpenAI, Anthropic and Responses APIs.
knobs.label: Bind port

knobs.help: A GPU UUID (GPU-xxxx..., as nvidia-smi -L prints) or an nvidia-smi index. A unique UUID prefix is enough.
knobs.label: GPU

knobs.help: Comma-separated allow-list for browser clients. Empty disables CORS headers; '*' allows any origin.
knobs.label: CORS origins

knobs.help: How many requests the scheduler runs concurrently. Raising it costs KV cache.
knobs.label: Max running requests

knobs.help: Output budget applied to requests that do not specify one.
knobs.label: Default max output tokens

knobs.help: Override the context length taken from the checkpoint's rotary config.
knobs.label: Max sequence length

knobs.help: Chunked-prefill chunk size in tokens. Larger chunks prefill faster but delay decode.
knobs.label: Prefill chunk size

knobs.help: Largest batch size captured as a CUDA graph. Capture cost grows with the value.
knobs.label: CUDA graph max batch

knobs.help: Emit one scheduler status line every N decode forwards.
knobs.label: Decode log interval

knobs.help: Dedicated tokenizer processes. 0 shares the tokenizer with the detokenizer.
knobs.label: Tokenizer processes

knobs.help: TP degree. Give one --gpu entry per rank; single-GPU serving leaves this at 1.
knobs.label: Tensor parallel size

knobs.help: Turn off PyNCCL for tensor parallelism and fall back to the default collectives.
knobs.label: Disable PyNCCL

knobs.help: Preserve a decode reuse point just after a tool-call opener, so rewriting an echoed tool call only invalidates the call body.
knobs.label: Special-token checkpoints

knobs.help: Fraction of free VRAM the engine may use for weights, MoE cache and KV combined.
knobs.label: Memory ratio

knobs.help: Fix KV capacity in pages instead of sizing it from leftover VRAM.
knobs.label: KV capacity (pages)

knobs.help: Fix KV capacity in tokens. Must be a multiple of the resolved page size.
knobs.label: KV capacity (tokens)

knobs.help: KV page granularity. DSV4 forces 128, the TRTLLM backend needs 16/32/64, SWA models require 1.
knobs.label: KV page size

knobs.help: 'radix' reuses shared prefixes across requests (SWA- and GDN-aware variants are picked automatically); 'naive' opts out.
knobs.label: KV cache strategy

knobs.help: Attention kernel. Each backend serves one attention type, so 'auto' is almost always right: m3_sparse is MiniMax-M3's block-sparse kernel, qsa_sparse Qwen3.8-Flash-Next's, dsa and dsv4_sparse DeepSeek's.
knobs.label: Attention backend

knobs.help: KV token floor held back before --moe-cache-auto spends the rest of VRAM on experts.
knobs.label: KV reserve tokens

knobs.help: fused keeps experts resident on GPU; offload streams misses over PCIe; cpu computes them on the host; hybrid splits the two. auto never picks fused.
knobs.label: MoE strategy

knobs.help: Absolute number of GPU expert slots.
knobs.label: MoE cache size (slots)

knobs.help: Fraction of all experts to keep cached on GPU.
knobs.label: MoE cache rate

knobs.help: Size the expert cache from free VRAM, giving MoE priority over KV down to the reserve floor.
knobs.label: MoE cache auto-size

knobs.help: Eviction policy for the unified expert slot cache.
knobs.label: MoE eviction policy

knobs.help: Worker threads for the cpu and hybrid executors. 0 means one per physical core.
knobs.label: MoE CPU threads

knobs.help: With offload or hybrid: which MoE layers decode on the CPU. An id list ('3,7,11'), a count ('8'), a fraction ('0.5'), or 'auto'. 'auto' is for Windows/WSL, where CUDA pinned memory is capped, and needs an expert format the CPU executor serves (bf16, nvfp4, mxfp4) -- not fp8.
knobs.label: MoE CPU layers

knobs.help: With hybrid: experts fetched over PCIe per layer per step; the rest go to the CPU. -1 reads the bandwidth profile, 0 never fetches.
knobs.label: Hybrid max fetch

knobs.help: Which kernel serves each quantized layer type: comma-separated layer[.kind]=name entries, e.g. 'moe.nvfp4=marlin' or 'linear=triton'. A bare layer applies to every one of its kinds whose table lists that kernel; unlisted tables stay automatic. Forcing a kernel fails loudly if it cannot run here.
knobs.label: Quant kernels

knobs.help: How expert banks are read into host RAM. 'serial' is the low-memory path; 'parallel' is faster but needs room for a whole-shard buffer.
knobs.label: Expert bank load

knobs.help: Where a PLE n-gram table lives. 'pinned' preloads it into page-locked host RAM, which is fast but costs tens of GiB.
knobs.label: PLE table backend

knobs.help: During prefill, copy cache-resident experts device-side and stream only misses. Needs CUDA 13 and a cache larger than 2x the per-layer expert count.
knobs.label: Prefill hit D2D copy

knobs.help: Turn off the two-buffer overlap for prefill expert copies.
knobs.label: Disable prefill overlap

knobs.help: Grammar used to parse tool calls out of the model's output. 'auto' infers it from the model family.
knobs.label: Tool-call parser

knobs.help: Splits chain-of-thought into reasoning_content. 'off' leaves it inline in the message.
knobs.label: Reasoning parser

knobs.help: 'model' fills unspecified temperature/top_k/top_p from the checkpoint's generation_config.json, which reasoning models generally need.
knobs.label: Sampling defaults

knobs.help: Report prefix-cache hits in each response's usage block. On /v1/messages this also makes input_tokens exclude the cached prefix.
knobs.label: Report cache hits
